property_summary: Only externally-originating transactions from jojoTeam (tx.origin == jojoTeam) may succeed in the mutant, whereas in the original only msg.sender == jojoTeam may succeed; therefore for the original: if msg.sender != jojoTeam then newEmergencyOracle must revert.
change_summary: Tighten the onlyJojoTeam check to require tx.origin equals jojoTeam instead of msg.sender, changing which callers are allowed and thus whether newEmergencyOracle can be called.
